environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. AWS WAFv2 WebACL is associated with the ALB. The WebACL contains two rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 0: AWS managed rule group 'AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet' with all rules in default action (BLOCK), which includes SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING (blocks query strings > 2048 bytes) and CrossSiteScripting_QUERYSTRING. (2) Priority 1: A custom rule 'restrict-query-param-chars' of type RegexPatternSet match on QueryString component, pattern '[^a-zA-Z0-9_.@\-\s,]' with BLOCK action and text transformation URL_DECODE applied before matching. The custom regex pattern blocks any query string containing characters outside the alphanumeric set plus period, at-sign, hyphen, underscore, comma, and whitespace after URL decoding. CloudWatch metrics confirm both rules are actively evaluating and blocking requests (non-zero BlockedRequests metric over trailing 24h).
